scenes.chapter: The Optimal Input to a Discrete Channel
scenes.title: The Optimal Input to a Discrete Channel

sentences.en: Must a capacity-achieving input use every symbol? Let a finite DMC have input x and output y.
sentences.zh: 达到容量的输入分布必须使用每个符号吗？设有限DMC的输入为x、输出为y。

sentences.en: Each input x selects an output distribution W sub x.
sentences.zh: 每个输入x对应一个输出分布W_x。

sentences.en: Choose an input distribution p over the finite input alphabet.
sentences.zh: 在有限输入字母表上选取输入分布p。

sentences.en: The induced output distribution is q sub p.
sentences.zh: 由此诱导的输出分布记为q_p。

sentences.en: Mutual information equals the input-weighted row divergences from that output law.
sentences.zh: 互信息等于各输入行相对输出分布的散度加权和。

sentences.en: Write I of p as the sum of p sub x times D of W sub x relative to q sub p.
sentences.zh: 写作I(p)=Σ_x p_x D(W_x‖q_p)。

sentences.en: The capacity C is the maximum of I over the input simplex.
sentences.zh: 容量C是输入单纯形上I的最大值。

sentences.en: A maximizer exists because the simplex is compact and mutual information is continuous.
sentences.zh: 单纯形紧致且互信息连续，因此最大值存在。

sentences.en: First remove output symbols unreachable from every input.
sentences.zh: 先删除所有输入都无法到达的输出符号。

sentences.en: Their probabilities are always zero and they affect no divergence.
sentences.zh: 这些符号的概率始终为零，不影响任何散度。

sentences.en: Call an output reachable if at least one input can produce it.
sentences.zh: 若至少一个输入可产生某输出，就称该输出可达。

sentences.en: At an optimal input, every reachable output has positive probability.
sentences.zh: 在最优输入下，每个可达输出的概率都为正。

sentences.en: Suppose instead that a reachable output y has zero optimal probability.
sentences.zh: 反设某个可达输出y在最优分布下概率为零。

sentences.en: Choose an input row that assigns positive mass to y.
sentences.zh: 选择一个在y处赋正概率的输入行。

sentences.en: Mix a small amount epsilon of that row into the optimal input.
sentences.zh: 向最优输入混入少量ε的该输入行。

sentences.en: The new output law gives y probability proportional to epsilon.
sentences.zh: 新输出分布会赋予y与ε成比例的概率。

sentences.en: Its output entropy gains a positive epsilon log one over epsilon term.
sentences.zh: 其输出熵增加正的εlog(1/ε)项。

sentences.en: Changes at already-positive output coordinates are only of order epsilon.
sentences.zh: 原先已为正的输出坐标，其熵变化只有ε阶。

sentences.en: The conditional output entropy changes only linearly with epsilon.
sentences.zh: 条件输出熵只随ε线性变化。

sentences.en: For sufficiently small epsilon, the entropy gain dominates.
sentences.zh: ε足够小时，熵增益占主导。

sentences.en: That would increase mutual information and contradict optimality.
sentences.zh: 这会提高互信息，与最优性矛盾。

sentences.en: Thus logarithmic derivatives are well defined on every reachable output.
sentences.zh: 因此每个可达输出上的对数导数都有定义。

sentences.en: Consider moving a small probability mass from the optimum toward row i.
sentences.zh: 考虑将少量概率质量从最优分布移向第i行。

sentences.en: The output direction is W sub i minus q star.
sentences.zh: 输出分布的变化方向为W_i−q*。

sentences.en: Differentiating its entropy gives minus the sum of that direction times log two q star.
sentences.zh: 对其熵求导，得到负的Σ_y(W_i(y)−q*(y))log₂q*(y)。

sentences.en: The derivative of conditional entropy is row entropy of W sub i minus the current average row entropy.
sentences.zh: 条件熵导数为第i行熵减去当前平均行熵。

sentences.en: Subtracting these two derivatives gives the row divergence minus the current mutual information.
sentences.zh: 两导数相减，得到行散度减去当前互信息。

sentences.en: The directional derivative of mutual information is D of W sub i relative to q star minus C.
sentences.zh: 互信息方向导数为D(W_i‖q*)−C。

sentences.en: At a maximum, each feasible directional derivative is nonpositive. Must an unused row have divergence C?
sentences.zh: 在最大值处，每个可行单侧方向导数都非正。未使用行的散度也必须等于C吗？

sentences.en: Therefore every input row has divergence at most C.
sentences.zh: 因此每个输入行的散度都不超过C。

sentences.en: Now average these divergences using the optimal input probabilities.
sentences.zh: 现在用最优输入概率对这些散度取平均。

sentences.en: Their weighted average equals mutual information at the optimum.
sentences.zh: 这些散度的加权平均等于最优点处的互信息。

sentences.en: That value is C.
sentences.zh: 该值就是C。

sentences.en: An average of values at most C equals C only when every used value equals C.
sentences.zh: 不超过C的数值平均为C，意味着每个被使用的数值都等于C。

sentences.en: Thus positive-probability input rows satisfy D of W sub i relative to q star equals C.
sentences.zh: 因此正概率输入行满足D(W_i‖q*)=C。

sentences.en: Unused rows need only satisfy the inequality at most C.
sentences.zh: 未使用行只需满足不超过C的不等式。

sentences.en: This is a boundary condition, not equality for every row.
sentences.zh: 这是边界条件，并非所有输入行都取等号。

sentences.en: For any input p, mutual information equals its input-weighted average row divergence to q star, minus the divergence of q sub p relative to q star.
sentences.zh: 对任意p，I(p)=Σ_i p_iD(W_i‖q*)−D(q_p‖q*)。

sentences.en: To check sufficiency, start with any candidate input and call its information value J.
sentences.zh: 验证充分性时，从任意候选输入出发，将其互信息记为J。

sentences.en: Suppose every row divergence to its output law is at most J.
sentences.zh: 假设每行到其输出分布的散度均至多为J。

sentences.en: Add and subtract the log of that candidate output law inside each row divergence.
sentences.zh: 在每个行散度中，加减候选输出分布的对数。

sentences.en: Averaging the added output log ratio produces the divergence between the two output laws.
sentences.zh: 对所加的输出对数比取平均，就得到两个输出分布之间的散度。

sentences.en: The same identity therefore bounds every other input’s information by J.
sentences.zh: 因此同一恒等式将所有其他输入的互信息界为J。

sentences.en: The candidate attains that value and is globally optimal.
sentences.zh: 候选自身达到该值，因此全局最优。

sentences.en: The same equal-marginal-benefit idea will reappear in power allocation.
sentences.zh: 同一等边际收益思想将在功率分配中再次出现。

sentences.en: Now maximize a differentiable concave objective F of powers p sub i.
sentences.zh: 现在最大化关于功率p_i的可微凹目标F。

sentences.en: Each power must be nonnegative.
sentences.zh: 每个功率都必须非负。

sentences.en: Their sum cannot exceed the budget P.
sentences.zh: 功率总和不能超过预算P。

sentences.en: Write the constraints as sum p sub i minus P at most zero.
sentences.zh: 将总功率约束写成Σp_i−P≤0。

sentences.en: Write each lower bound as negative p sub i at most zero.
sentences.zh: 将每个下界写成−p_i≤0。

sentences.en: Assign multiplier lambda at least zero to the total-power constraint.
sentences.zh: 给总功率约束分配非负乘子λ。

sentences.en: Assign multiplier mu sub i at least zero to each lower bound.
sentences.zh: 给每个下界分配非负乘子μ_i。

sentences.en: For this maximization convention, subtract lambda times the total constraint.
sentences.zh: 按此最大化约定，从目标中减去λ乘总约束。

sentences.en: Adding mu sub i times p sub i enforces its nonnegative boundary.
sentences.zh: 加上μ_i p_i项以处理其非负边界。

sentences.en: The Lagrangian is F minus lambda times the difference between total allocated power and budget P, plus the sum of mu sub i times p sub i.
sentences.zh: 拉格朗日函数为F−λ(Σp_i−P)+Σμ_i p_i。

sentences.en: Stationarity sets every power derivative minus lambda plus mu sub i equal to zero.
sentences.zh: 驻点条件令每个功率导数减λ再加μ_i等于零。

sentences.en: Primal feasibility requires nonnegative powers and total power at most P.
sentences.zh: 原始可行性要求功率非负且总功率不超过P。

sentences.en: Dual feasibility requires lambda and every mu sub i nonnegative.
sentences.zh: 对偶可行性要求λ与每个μ_i均非负。

sentences.en: Complementary slackness sets lambda times the difference between total allocated power and budget P to zero.
sentences.zh: 互补松弛令λ(Σp_i−P)=0。

sentences.en: For each mode, mu i times p i equals zero. If power is positive, which factor vanishes?
sentences.zh: 每个模式都满足μ_i p_i=0。若功率为正，哪个因子必须为零？

sentences.en: Thus a positive power forces its lower-bound multiplier to zero.
sentences.zh: 因此正功率会迫使其下界乘子为零。

sentences.en: A zero power may instead have a positive lower-bound multiplier.
sentences.zh: 零功率则可能对应正的下界乘子。

sentences.en: If the total budget is slack, lambda must be zero.
sentences.zh: 若总预算未用满，则λ必须为零。

sentences.en: For a strictly increasing objective and positive P, the budget is tight.
sentences.zh: 若目标严格递增且P为正，预算必定用满。

sentences.en: Then lambda can represent the marginal value of additional budget.
sentences.zh: 此时λ可表示增加预算的边际价值。

sentences.en: At a strictly positive power, stationarity gives derivative equal to lambda.
sentences.zh: 功率严格为正时，驻点条件令导数等于λ。

sentences.en: At a zero power, stationarity gives derivative at most lambda.
sentences.zh: 在零功率处，驻点条件给出导数至多为λ。

sentences.en: A larger derivative at an unused mode would make a transfer from a used mode improve the objective.
sentences.zh: 若未用模式的导数更大，从已用模式转移少量功率就会提高目标。

sentences.en: The constraints are affine, so the feasible region is convex.
sentences.zh: 这些约束是仿射的，因此可行域是凸集。

sentences.en: A concave objective makes any feasible KKT point globally optimal.
sentences.zh: 目标为凹函数时，任一满足KKT的可行点都是全局最优。

sentences.en: For any feasible q, concavity bounds F of q by F of p star plus the dot product of its gradient with the difference q minus p star.
sentences.zh: 对任意可行q，凹性给出F(q)≤F(p*)+∇F(p*)·(q−p*)。

sentences.en: Substitute the gradient components lambda minus mu sub i from stationarity.
sentences.zh: 由驻点条件，将梯度分量替换成λ−μ_i。

sentences.en: The lambda contribution is nonpositive by the total constraint and complementary slackness.
sentences.zh: 由总约束与互补松弛，λ对应的项非正。

sentences.en: The remaining contribution is minus the sum of mu sub i q sub i, also nonpositive.
sentences.zh: 其余项为−Σμ_iq_i，也非正。

sentences.en: Thus no feasible q can improve the objective.
sentences.zh: 因此不存在目标更优的可行q。

sentences.en: For positive P, choose all powers positive with sum strictly below P.
sentences.zh: P为正时，可选全正且总和严格低于P的功率。

sentences.en: This is a Slater point and supplies the constraint qualification.
sentences.zh: 这就是Slater点，并提供约束资格条件。

sentences.en: KKT conditions are then necessary as well as sufficient.
sentences.zh: 因此KKT条件既必要也充分。

sentences.en: At P equal zero, the only feasible allocation is zero.
sentences.zh: P等于零时，唯一可行分配为全零。

sentences.en: That boundary case is solved directly without claiming Slater.
sentences.zh: 该边界情形直接求解，不宣称满足Slater条件。

sentences.en: A one-variable example checks the multiplier sign.
sentences.zh: 一个单变量例子可以核对乘子符号。

sentences.en: Maximize log one plus p subject to p at most P and p nonnegative.
sentences.zh: 在p≤P且p≥0下最大化log(1+p)。

sentences.en: Its optimum uses p equal P, with positive lambda and zero mu.
sentences.zh: 最优解用满p=P，λ为正而μ为零。

sentences.en: This matches the stationarity equation and tight budget.
sentences.zh: 这与驻点方程及紧约束相符。

sentences.en: Next apply these conditions to independent Gaussian modes.
sentences.zh: 接下来将这些条件用于独立高斯模式。

sentences.en: Consider a finite collection of independent real Gaussian channel modes.
sentences.zh: 考虑有限个相互独立的实高斯信道模式。

sentences.en: Mode i has noise variance N sub i, strictly positive.
sentences.zh: 第i个模式的噪声方差为N_i，且严格为正。

sentences.en: Allocate nonnegative input power p sub i to each mode.
sentences.zh: 为每个模式分配非负输入功率p_i。

sentences.en: The total allocation cannot exceed P.
sentences.zh: 分配总功率不得超过P。

sentences.en: For one real mode, capacity is one half log two of one plus p sub i over N sub i.
sentences.zh: 一个实模式的容量为二分之一log₂(1+p_i/N_i)。

sentences.en: With independent input coordinates as well, the mutual informations add across modes.
sentences.zh: 若输入坐标也相互独立，互信息即可跨模式相加。

sentences.en: The optimization objective is the sum of these mode capacities.
sentences.zh: 优化目标是这些模式容量之和。

sentences.en: Only the sum-power constraint couples the allocations.
sentences.zh: 只有总功率约束将各分配耦合起来。

sentences.en: A lower noise variance gives a larger initial marginal return.
sentences.zh: 噪声方差较低的模式具有更大的初始边际收益。

sentences.en: Different noise levels therefore make equal allocation suspicious.
sentences.zh: 因此噪声水平不同会使均匀分配值得怀疑。

sentences.en: We must also justify that separate powers capture the full vector channel.
sentences.zh: 还需说明分配独立功率已能刻画完整向量信道。

sentences.en: Let X vector be any possibly correlated input vector.
sentences.zh: 令X向量为任意可能相关的输入向量。

sentences.en: Conditional output entropy given X equals the sum of noise entropies.
sentences.zh: 给定X时的输出条件熵等于各噪声熵之和。

sentences.en: Output entropy is at most the sum of marginal output entropies.
sentences.zh: 输出熵至多为各边缘输出熵之和。

sentences.en: Each marginal output variance is its input variance plus N sub i.
sentences.zh: 每个边缘输出方差等于输入方差加N_i。

sentences.en: Gaussian maximum entropy bounds that marginal entropy.
sentences.zh: 高斯最大熵性质界定该边缘熵。

sentences.en: Input variance is no larger than its assigned second moment p sub i.
sentences.zh: 输入方差不超过分配的二阶矩p_i。

sentences.en: Subtracting the noise entropies gives the sum of scalar capacity bounds.
sentences.zh: 减去噪声熵后得到各标量容量界之和。

sentences.en: Thus correlations cannot improve on the separate-mode objective.
sentences.zh: 因此跨模式相关不能超过独立模式目标。

sentences.en: Independent Gaussian inputs with variances p sub i attain each bound.
sentences.zh: 方差为p_i的独立高斯输入可达到各自上界。

sentences.en: They also make output modes independent.
sentences.zh: 它们也使输出模式相互独立。

sentences.en: So maximizing the sum of mode formulas gives the vector capacity.
sentences.zh: 因此最大化各模式公式之和即得向量容量。

sentences.en: The objective is a sum of concave logarithms.
sentences.zh: 该目标是凹对数函数之和。

sentences.en: Each mode utility is strictly increasing for every finite nonnegative power.
sentences.zh: 每个模式效用在有限非负功率上都严格递增。

sentences.en: Every term has strictly negative second derivative throughout the nonnegative power range.
sentences.zh: 每项在整个非负功率范围内均有严格负的二阶导数。

sentences.en: With P positive, the optimal allocation is unique.
sentences.zh: P为正时，最优分配唯一。

sentences.en: The sum-power budget is used fully because every mode benefits from added power.
sentences.zh: 每个模式都受益于增功率，因此总预算会用满。

sentences.en: The model here uses real modes and one half per logarithm.
sentences.zh: 这里采用实模式，每个对数前有二分之一。

sentences.en: Complex modes would require a separately stated variance convention.
sentences.zh: 复模式需要另行声明方差约定。

sentences.en: Do not silently double the real-mode capacity.
sentences.zh: 不要在未说明时将实模式容量加倍。

sentences.en: The finite-mode model will make the active-set calculation explicit.
sentences.zh: 有限模式模型将使活跃集计算明确可行。

sentences.en: The modes with excessive noise may receive no power.
sentences.zh: 噪声过大的模式可能得不到功率。

sentences.en: Their derivatives will determine the active-set threshold.
sentences.zh: 它们的导数将决定活跃集阈值。

sentences.en: The solution remains subject to one shared total budget.
sentences.zh: 所有解仍受一个共同总预算约束。

sentences.en: Next, stationarity turns equal marginal returns into a water level.
sentences.zh: 接下来，驻点条件会将边际收益相等转化为水位。

sentences.en: For mode i, differentiate one half log two of one plus p sub i over N sub i.
sentences.zh: 对第i项二分之一log₂(1+p_i/N_i)求导。

sentences.en: The derivative is one divided by the product of two, natural log two, and the quantity N sub i plus p sub i.
sentences.zh: 导数为1/[2ln2(N_i+p_i)]。

sentences.en: Let lambda be the nonnegative price of total power.
sentences.zh: 令λ为总功率的非负价格。

sentences.en: The multiplier is a marginal price; the water level will be its scaled reciprocal.
sentences.zh: 该乘子是边际价格，水位则是其带比例的倒数。

sentences.en: For a mode receiving positive power, its lower-bound multiplier is zero.
sentences.zh: 获得正功率的模式，其下界乘子为零。

sentences.en: Stationarity sets that mode derivative equal to lambda.
sentences.zh: 驻点条件令该模式导数等于λ。

sentences.en: Thus all active modes have equal marginal capacity per extra watt.
sentences.zh: 因此所有活跃模式每增加一瓦的边际容量相同。

sentences.en: For an unused mode, its derivative at zero is no greater than lambda.
sentences.zh: 对未使用模式，其零点导数不超过λ。

sentences.en: If it exceeded lambda, transferring power there would help.
sentences.zh: 若其超过λ，将功率转移到该模式便会有利。

sentences.en: For P positive, at least one powered mode has positive derivative, forcing lambda to be positive.
sentences.zh: P为正时，至少一个有功率模式的导数为正，从而λ为正。

sentences.en: Define the water level nu as one divided by the product of two, natural log two, and lambda.
sentences.zh: 定义水位ν=1/(2ln2λ)。

sentences.en: The symbols nu and lambda describe different quantities.
sentences.zh: ν与λ表示不同量。

sentences.en: The multiplier lambda is a marginal price.
sentences.zh: 乘子λ是边际价格。

sentences.en: The water level nu has units of noise variance.
sentences.zh: 水位ν具有噪声方差的单位。

sentences.en: Solving the active stationarity equation gives p sub i equal nu minus N sub i.
sentences.zh: 求解活跃模式驻点式得p_i=ν−N_i。

sentences.en: Nonnegative power clips that expression at zero.
sentences.zh: 功率非负约束将该表达式截断于零。

sentences.en: Therefore p sub i equals the positive part of nu minus N sub i.
sentences.zh: 因此p_i=(ν−N_i)^+。

sentences.en: The water level is chosen so all allocated powers sum to P.
sentences.zh: 水位由所有分配功率之和等于P来确定。

sentences.en: The allocated sum increases continuously with the water level while modes activate.
sentences.zh: 模式逐渐激活时，分配总和随水位连续增加。

sentences.en: For positive P, this budget equality is active.
sentences.zh: P为正时，该预算等式活跃。

sentences.en: Sort the noise variances from smallest to largest.
sentences.zh: 将噪声方差从小到大排序。

sentences.en: Begin by assuming the k smallest modes are active.
sentences.zh: 先假设最小的k个模式活跃。

sentences.en: Their total power equation is k nu minus their noise sum equals P.
sentences.zh: 它们的总功率方程为kν减去噪声之和等于P。

sentences.en: Solve to get nu sub k as P plus the sum of the first k noise variances, with that entire numerator divided by k.
sentences.zh: 解得ν_k=(P加前k个噪声方差之和)/k。

sentences.en: If every mode is active, there is no next-noise upper test.
sentences.zh: 若所有模式均活跃，则无需检查下一个噪声阈值。

sentences.en: The active-set test is N sub k less than nu sub k.
sentences.zh: 活跃集检验为N_k<ν_k。

sentences.en: The next mode stays inactive when nu sub k is at most the noise variance of mode k plus one.
sentences.zh: 当ν_k≤N_{k+1}时，下一个模式保持不活跃。

sentences.en: Equality at a noise floor still gives zero power. For floors one, two, five, when does mode three switch on?
sentences.zh: 水位等于噪声底时，功率仍为零。噪声底为一、二、五时，第三个模式何时开启？

sentences.en: It stays dry up through budget seven and receives power strictly above seven. Raising P raises the water level.
sentences.zh: 预算不超过七时，它仍是干的；严格超过七才分到功率。增加P会抬高水位。

sentences.en: Increasing one noise floor can deactivate its mode.
sentences.zh: 提高某个噪声底可能使该模式退出活跃集。

sentences.en: The rule fills only modes whose floors lie below the water.
sentences.zh: 该规则只填充噪声底低于水位的模式。

sentences.en: Each active mode then has the same marginal derivative.
sentences.zh: 每个活跃模式随后具有相同边际导数。

sentences.en: Inactive modes have no greater derivative than the shared price.
sentences.zh: 不活跃模式的导数不超过共同价格。

sentences.en: These are precisely the KKT stationarity and complementary conditions.
sentences.zh: 这正是KKT驻点条件与互补条件。

sentences.en: Concavity makes the resulting allocation globally optimal.
sentences.zh: 由凹性，所得分配是全局最优的。

sentences.en: A numeric example will check the budget and both derivative cases.
sentences.zh: 数值例子将核对预算及两类导数条件。

sentences.en: The next chapter reports computed values as arithmetic, not measurements.
sentences.zh: 下一章将把计算值作为算术结果报告，而非测量值。

sentences.en: Take three real modes with noise variances one, two, and five.
sentences.zh: 取三个实模式，噪声方差分别为1、2、5。

sentences.en: Set the total power budget P equal to six.
sentences.zh: 令总功率预算P=6。

sentences.en: Assume the first two modes are active.
sentences.zh: 假设前两个模式活跃。

sentences.en: Their water level is the sum of six, one, and two, all divided by two.
This gives nu equal to four point five.
The first power is four point five minus one, or three point five.
sentences.zh: 第一个功率为4.5−1，即3.5。

sentences.en: The second power is four point five minus two, or two point five.
sentences.zh: 第二个功率为4.5−2，即2.5。

sentences.en: The third noise floor is five, above water level 4.5. Should that mode receive any power?
sentences.zh: 第三个噪声底为五，高于水位4.5。这个模式应该分到功率吗？

sentences.en: It receives zero power.
sentences.zh: 它获得零功率。

sentences.en: The allocation is three point five, two point five, and zero.
Their sum is exactly six.
sentences.zh: 它们的和恰为6。

sentences.en: The arithmetic budget residual is zero.
sentences.zh: 算术预算残差为零。

sentences.en: For active mode one, noise plus power equals four point five.
sentences.zh: 第一个活跃模式的噪声加功率为4.5。

sentences.en: The same total holds for active mode two.
sentences.zh: 第二个活跃模式的总量也为4.5。

sentences.en: Both derivatives therefore equal one divided by the product of nine and natural log two.
sentences.zh: 因此两者导数均为1/(9ln2)。

sentences.en: The shadow price lambda is also one divided by the product of nine and natural log two.
sentences.zh: 影子价格λ也为1/(9ln2)。

sentences.en: For unused mode three, the derivative at zero is one divided by the product of ten and natural log two.
sentences.zh: 第三个未用模式在零功率处的导数为1/(10ln2)。

sentences.en: That derivative is smaller than lambda.
sentences.zh: 该导数小于λ。

sentences.en: Its lower-bound multiplier is lambda minus that derivative.
sentences.zh: 其下界乘子为λ减去该导数。

sentences.en: This equals one divided by the product of ninety and natural log two.
All primal, dual, stationarity, and complementarity checks hold.
sentences.zh: 原始可行、对偶可行、驻点与互补条件均成立。

sentences.en: The optimized capacity is the sum of three half-log terms.
sentences.zh: 最优容量是三个二分之一对数项之和。

sentences.en: For powers three point five, two point five, and zero, it is about one point six six nine nine two five bits.
The unit is bits per vector use.
sentences.zh: 单位是每次向量使用的比特数。

sentences.en: Now allocate two units of power to every mode instead.
sentences.zh: 现在改为每个模式都分配2单位功率。

sentences.en: Equal allocation uses total power six too. Does it achieve the same capacity?
sentences.zh: 均分同样使用总功率六。它能达到相同的容量吗？

sentences.en: Its capacity is about one point five three five one nine five bits per vector use.
sentences.zh: 其容量约为每次向量使用1.535195比特。

sentences.en: The difference comes from directing more power toward lower noise.
sentences.zh: 差异来自将更多功率分配给较低噪声模式。

sentences.en: Both values are direct formula calculations, not physical measurements.
sentences.zh: 两个数值都是公式直接计算所得，并非物理测量。

sentences.en: Displayed rounding does not change the underlying allocation.
sentences.zh: 显示时的舍入不会改变底层分配。

sentences.en: The third mode remains inactive because its marginal return is lower.
sentences.zh: 第三个模式保持不活跃，因为其边际收益较低。

sentences.en: A numerical audit checks equations rather than the water-tank drawing.
sentences.zh: 数值核查依据方程，而非水箱图像。

sentences.en: For other noise lists, sorting gives the active set systematically.
sentences.zh: 对其他噪声列表，排序可系统确定活跃集。

sentences.en: For continuous spectra, sums will become integrals.
sentences.zh: 对连续频谱，求和将变为积分。

sentences.en: That extension leads to spectral water-filling in the next episode.
sentences.zh: 该推广将引出下一集的频谱注水。
